inline.s: [Suddenly I transcended the world and the world-transcending, and the ten directions were round and bright.]
Suddenly I transcended the world and the world-transcending, and the ten directions were perfectly bright and complete.

the worlds of the ten directions merge without obstruction. The whole earth is the radiance of my own nature, and all of space is the substance and form of my own nature. All the dharmas of the ten directions are none other than the radiance of my own nature, all-pervading and perfectly complete.

[I attained two supreme excellences: first, above, I united with the wondrous enlightened true mind of all the Buddhas of the ten directions and shared the same compassionate power as all the Tathagatas; second, below, I united with all living beings of the six realms and shared the same compassionate yearning of all sentient beings.]

I attained two supreme excellences: First, above, I united with the originally wondrous, enlightened true mind realized by all the Buddhas of the ten directions, possessing the same compassionate power as all the Buddhas. Second, below, I united with all living beings of the six realms (mind joined with theirs, responsive to every appeal), sharing the same compassionate yearning as all sentient beings (feeling within myself their suffering and their longing to escape suffering and attain bliss).
the sacred power to draw forth the suffering of all living beings and to give bliss to all living beings,

feeling within herself the suffering of all living beings and their longing to escape pain and attain joy, this is our great compassionate, great merciful Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva who rescues us from suffering.

[Two supreme excellences: above, one with all the Buddhas; below, one with all beings.] [Compassionate power: the power to draw forth the suffering of all beings and to give bliss to all beings.] [Compassionate yearning: ‘bei’ is sorrow, ‘yang’ is longing; beings, in the torment of suffering, grieve over their pain and long to attain bliss.] [Responsive to every appeal: when beings, with a deep mind, pray with pure karmic causes for Avalokitesvara’s compassionate deliverance, their longing heart immediately resonates with and perfectly accords with Avalokitesvara’s unconditioned great compassion; the channel of communication receiving Avalokitesvara’s empowerment is thereby unimpeded. Hence the unobstructed wondrous function and effortless wondrous power realized by Avalokitesvara — transcending every obstruction in the world — can bless them, arouse the unobstructed wondrous function originally inherent in their mind-nature, and so manifest as the inconceivable resonance that surpasses the obstacles of worldly matter, time, and space.]
